formation_reference_en: Noun + に際して / Verb-dict + に際して / Noun + に際しての + Noun
meaning_reference_en: on the occasion of; when; at the time of
notes_reference_en: Formal; for special, one-off occasions (ceremonies, departures, contracts). Near-synonym of 〜にあたって, which adds a sense of preparing for or facing the event; に際して simply marks the occasion.

formation_reference_en: Noun + に伴って / Verb-dict + の + に伴って / Noun + に伴う + Noun
meaning_reference_en: along with; as; accompanying
notes_reference_en: 〜に伴い is the more written form. Like 〜につれて it can describe gradual change, but it also covers one-off events that bring about another (e.g. a relocation).

formation_reference_en: Noun + に応じて / Noun + に応じた + Noun
meaning_reference_en: according to; depending on; in response to
notes_reference_en: B is adjusted to match A (ability, budget, season, requests). Compare 〜次第で, which stresses that the outcome is decided entirely by A.

formation_reference_en: Noun + に反して / Noun + に反する + Noun / Noun + に反した + Noun
meaning_reference_en: contrary to; against; in violation of
notes_reference_en: Used with nouns like 予想, 期待, 意思, 規則. With a rule or law as the noun, it means 'in violation of'.

formation_reference_en: Noun + に基づいて / Noun + に基づく + Noun / Noun + に基づいた + Noun
meaning_reference_en: based on; on the basis of
notes_reference_en: The basis is a firm standard such as data, law, facts or experience, and B follows it closely. Compare 〜をもとに, used for material from which something new is created.

formation_reference_en: Noun + にわたって / Noun + にわたる + Noun
meaning_reference_en: over; throughout; spanning (a whole period or area)
notes_reference_en: Stresses the full extent of a long period, a wide area or many items (多岐にわたる). Not used for short or small spans.

formation_reference_en: Noun + に沿って / Noun + に沿った + Noun
meaning_reference_en: along; in line with; following
notes_reference_en: Literal use: along a road, river or coast. Abstract use: following a plan, policy, or someone's wishes.

formation_reference_en: Noun + に加えて
meaning_reference_en: in addition to; on top of
notes_reference_en: Somewhat formal; 〜に加え is the written form. The added item is often marked with も.

formation_reference_en: Noun + をめぐって / Noun + をめぐる + Noun
meaning_reference_en: over; concerning; surrounding (an issue of dispute)
notes_reference_en: The verb that follows is about debate, conflict or competition (議論する, 対立する, 争う). Unlike 〜について, it isn't used for simply explaining a topic.

formation_reference_en: Noun + を通じて / Noun + を通して
meaning_reference_en: through; via; by way of; throughout (a period)
notes_reference_en: Largely interchangeable. 〜を通して tends to stress a deliberate process or experience; 〜を通じて is a little more formal and common with media, contacts and periods (一年を通じて).

formation_reference_en: Noun + をきっかけに / Noun + をきっかけとして / Verb-plain + の + をきっかけに
meaning_reference_en: taking the opportunity of; triggered by; with ... as the start
notes_reference_en: Marks an event that led to a new start or change. The formal equivalent 〜を契機に is common in writing.

formation_reference_en: Noun + を除いて / Noun + を除き / Noun + を除く + Noun
meaning_reference_en: except; excluding; apart from
notes_reference_en: More formal than 〜以外. 〜を除き is the written form.

formation_reference_en: Verb-plain / i-Adj + かのようだ / na-Adj + である + かのようだ / Noun + である + かのようだ
meaning_reference_en: as if; as though (when it isn't really so)
notes_reference_en: More literary than 〜ようだ and clearly signals that the comparison is not literally true. Often paired with まるで. Also 〜かのように / 〜かのような.

formation_reference_en: Verb-stem + かねない
meaning_reference_en: could well; might (lead to something bad)
notes_reference_en: Only for undesirable outcomes. Despite the ない, the meaning is positive: 'there's a real risk that ...'. Don't confuse with 〜かねる (cannot).

formation_reference_en: Verb-stem + かねる
meaning_reference_en: cannot; be unable to (polite refusal); find it hard to
notes_reference_en: A soft, formal way to decline, very common in customer service. It expresses reluctance or difficulty for the speaker, not physical inability.

formation_reference_en: Verb-nai stem + ずにはいられない
meaning_reference_en: can't help doing; can't resist doing
notes_reference_en: する becomes せずにはいられない. 〜ないではいられない is a slightly more conversational equivalent. An inner urge, unlike 〜ざるを得ない (forced by circumstances).

formation_reference_en: Verb-nai stem + ざるを得ない
meaning_reference_en: have no choice but to; cannot help but
notes_reference_en: Circumstances force an action the speaker doesn't really want to take. する becomes せざるを得ない. More formal than 〜しかない.

formation_reference_en: Verb-te + はいられない
meaning_reference_en: can't afford to (keep) doing; can't just
notes_reference_en: The situation doesn't allow one to stay in state A, so one feels pushed to act. Casual: 〜ちゃいられない / 〜てらんない.

formation_reference_en: Verb-dict / i-Adj / na-Adj + な + ものか
meaning_reference_en: no way (will I); as if; I'll never
notes_reference_en: Strong emotional denial or refusal; not a real question. Conversational form: 〜もんか; polite/feminine: 〜ものですか.

formation_reference_en: Verb-plain / i-Adj / na-Adj + な / na-Adj + である / Noun + である + ものの
meaning_reference_en: although; even though (but the expected result doesn't follow)
notes_reference_en: Admits the first fact, then says things didn't go as it would suggest. More written than 〜けれども.

formation_reference_en: Verb-dict (potential form) + ものなら
meaning_reference_en: if (it were possible); if only one could
notes_reference_en: For something hard or impossible to do; the main clause is often 〜たい or a challenge. Don't confuse with N1 〜(よ)うものなら ('if one dared to ..., something bad would happen').

formation_reference_en: Verb-dict + くらいなら / Verb-dict + ぐらいなら
meaning_reference_en: rather than; if it comes to (doing that), I'd rather
notes_reference_en: A is something the speaker strongly dislikes; B is the lesser evil or better choice, often with 〜ほうがいい / 〜ほうがましだ.

formation_reference_en: Verb-dict / i-Adj / na-Adj + な + ものがある
meaning_reference_en: there is something (about it that is) ...; it really is
notes_reference_en: Expresses the speaker's strong impression of a quality sensed in something. It's an evaluation, not a statement about literal existence.

formation_reference_en: Question word + … + Verb-plain / i-Adj / na-Adj + な + ことか
meaning_reference_en: how ...!; how much ...!
notes_reference_en: Usually paired with どんなに, どれほど, 何度, etc. Not a real question; it conveys deep feeling. Slightly written or dramatic in tone.

formation_reference_en: Verb-ta / i-Adj / na-Adj + な + ことに（は）
meaning_reference_en: (emotion)-ly; what is (surprising, sad, etc.) is that
notes_reference_en: An emotion word (驚いた, 残念な, うれしい, 不思議な) states the speaker's feeling before giving the fact. Fairly written.

formation_reference_en: Noun + の + ことだから
meaning_reference_en: knowing (someone); since it's (someone), surely
notes_reference_en: From what the speaker knows of a person's character, it leads to a guess about their behavior. Usually followed by だろう, きっと or に違いない.

formation_reference_en: Verb-dict + ことなく
meaning_reference_en: without (doing); without ever
notes_reference_en: A written equivalent of 〜ないで / 〜ずに, often implying that something one might expect to happen did not.

formation_reference_en: Verb-plain / i-Adj / na-Adj + な / na-Adj + である / Noun + である + ことから
meaning_reference_en: from the fact that; because; judging from
notes_reference_en: Gives the evidence or origin behind a name, judgment or conclusion. Common in explanations of place names and in reports.

formation_reference_en: Verb-nai / i-Adj-ku + ない / na-Adj + でない / Noun + でない + ことには
meaning_reference_en: unless; if ... not (then it can't happen)
notes_reference_en: The main clause is negative (分からない, できない, 始まらない): without A, B can't happen. More emphatic than 〜なければ.

formation_reference_en: Verb-plain + ことは + Verb-plain + が / i-Adj + ことは + i-Adj + が / na-Adj + な + ことは + na-Adj + だ + が
meaning_reference_en: it's true that ..., but; (I) do ..., but
notes_reference_en: The same word is repeated to admit something only partly before adding a reservation. けど replaces が in speech.

formation_reference_en: Verb-ta + あげく / Noun + の + あげく
meaning_reference_en: after (a long, troublesome process); in the end
notes_reference_en: The result is usually negative or disappointing. 〜末(に) is neutral and can end well; あげく stresses frustration. あげくの果てに is an intensified form.

formation_reference_en: Verb-dict / Verb-ta / na-Adj + な / Noun + の + あまり（に）
meaning_reference_en: so much that; out of excessive; because of too much
notes_reference_en: An extreme degree of a feeling or state leads to an unusual, often unwanted result. Mostly with emotion nouns (緊張, 心配, 驚き, 悲しみ).

formation_reference_en: Verb-plain / i-Adj / na-Adj + な / Noun + である + 上（に）
meaning_reference_en: besides; on top of; in addition to
notes_reference_en: Adds a second point of the same kind (good + good, bad + bad). に may be dropped in writing. It isn't normally followed by a command or request.

formation_reference_en: Verb-ta + 上で / Noun + の + 上で / Verb-dict + 上で
meaning_reference_en: after (doing), upon; in (doing), when it comes to
notes_reference_en: Verb-ta + 上で: do A first, then B on that basis. Verb-dict + 上で: 'in the process of / for the purpose of A'. Business writing often shortens it to ご確認の上.

formation_reference_en: Verb-plain / na-Adj + である / Noun + である + 以上（は）
meaning_reference_en: since; now that; as long as
notes_reference_en: From a given situation, draws an obligation, resolve or firm judgment. Near-synonym of 〜からには; 以上は sounds more formal and logical, からには more like personal resolve.

formation_reference_en: Verb-plain / Noun + である + からには
meaning_reference_en: now that; since (having done/being ..., one must)
notes_reference_en: Expresses resolve: having reached this situation, one should see it through. Often ends with 〜たい, 〜つもりだ, 〜なければならない. Compare 〜以上(は), which is more formal and neutral.

formation_reference_en: Verb-plain / i-Adj / na-Adj + だ / Noun + だ + からこそ
meaning_reference_en: precisely because; it is because ... that
notes_reference_en: Stresses that this reason, and no other, is the real one, often a reason the listener wouldn't expect. Frequently ends with 〜のだ.

formation_reference_en: Noun + からして
meaning_reference_en: judging from; (starting) even with; to begin with
notes_reference_en: Two uses: 'judging from X' (basis for a guess), and 'even X, let alone the rest', where one example stands for the whole, often critically.

formation_reference_en: Noun + からすると / Noun + からすれば
meaning_reference_en: judging from; from the standpoint of
notes_reference_en: Gives either the evidence for a judgment or the viewpoint of a person. Close to 〜から見ると; unlike 〜からいうと, it can take a person.

formation_reference_en: Noun + から見ると / Noun + から見れば
meaning_reference_en: from the point of view of; judging from; seen from
notes_reference_en: Looks at something from a person's position or from given evidence. 〜から見て and 〜から見ても are also common.

formation_reference_en: Noun + からいうと / Noun + からいって
meaning_reference_en: in terms of; from the standpoint of; judging by
notes_reference_en: The noun is a criterion or viewpoint (立場, 経験, 値段), not a person: say 親からすると, not ×親からいうと. 〜からいえば is also used.

formation_reference_en: Verb-dict / Verb-ta / Noun + の + 際（に）
meaning_reference_en: when; at the time of; on the occasion of
notes_reference_en: A formal version of 〜とき, common in announcements and instructions. Unlike 〜に際して, it's fine for everyday occasions.

formation_reference_en: Verb-stem + 次第 / Noun + 次第
meaning_reference_en: as soon as (then immediately)
notes_reference_en: Formal, for a planned future action that follows right after A (contacting, starting). Not used when the main clause is in the past. Compare 〜次第で (depending on).

formation_reference_en: Noun + 次第だ / Noun + 次第で / Noun + 次第では
meaning_reference_en: depending on; it depends on
notes_reference_en: The outcome is decided by A. 〜次第では points to one possible outcome among several.

formation_reference_en: Verb-ta + 末（に） / Noun + の + 末（に）
meaning_reference_en: after (a long process of); finally, at the end of
notes_reference_en: Neutral: the outcome may be good or bad and is often a decision or conclusion. Use 〜あげく when the result is negative or frustrating.

formation_reference_en: Verb-ta + ところで
meaning_reference_en: even if (it would be no use); no matter how much
notes_reference_en: The main clause says the effort is useless or the result wouldn't matter much. Often with いくら, どんなに, 今さら. Different from 〜たところ (when I did, I found).

formation_reference_en: Verb-ta + ところ
meaning_reference_en: when (I) did ..., (I found that); upon doing
notes_reference_en: Reports what turned out after an action, often a discovery. The result is a past fact beyond the speaker's control. More formal than 〜たら.

formation_reference_en: Verb-plain / i-Adj / na-Adj + な / Noun + ばかりか
meaning_reference_en: not only ... but also
notes_reference_en: Stronger than 〜だけでなく; the second item is often more surprising and marked by も, まで or さえ. Unlike 〜だけでなく, it isn't followed by commands or requests.

formation_reference_en: Verb-plain / i-Adj / na-Adj + な / na-Adj + である / Noun + である + ばかりに
meaning_reference_en: simply because; just because (with a bad result)
notes_reference_en: The main clause is an unwanted result, often with regret. The set form 〜たいばかりに ('just because one wanted to') explains a strong motive.

formation_reference_en: Verb-dict + ばかりだ
meaning_reference_en: keep (getting worse); only continue to
notes_reference_en: Change continuing in one direction, almost always for the worse. 〜一方だ (N3) is similar but can also describe neutral or good trends.

formation_reference_en: Noun + はもちろん / Noun + はもとより
meaning_reference_en: not to mention; of course ... and also
notes_reference_en: A is the obvious case; B is added with も or まで. 〜はもとより is more formal and written than 〜はもちろん.

formation_reference_en: Noun + はともかく / Noun + はともかくとして
meaning_reference_en: setting aside; regardless of; whatever about
notes_reference_en: Sets A aside to focus on B, which the speaker sees as more important. Compare 〜はさておき, used more to shelve a topic for now and move on.

formation_reference_en: Noun + はさておき
meaning_reference_en: leaving aside; putting aside (for now)
notes_reference_en: Often used to switch to the main point, as in 冗談はさておき or それはさておき. Slightly more formal than 〜はともかく.

formation_reference_en: Verb-plain / i-Adj / na-Adj + な / na-Adj + である / Noun + である + 反面
meaning_reference_en: on the other hand; while (it is ...)
notes_reference_en: Presents two opposite sides of the same thing. 〜一方で (N3) is broader and can also contrast two different things.

formation_reference_en: Verb-stem / Verb-nai / i-Adj / na-Adj / Noun + ながら（も）
meaning_reference_en: although; despite; while (contrary to expectation)
notes_reference_en: Not the 'while doing' ながら: the subject is in state A, yet B is true. Set phrases: 残念ながら, 知りながら, 及ばずながら.

formation_reference_en: Verb-stem + つつ / Verb-stem + つつも
meaning_reference_en: while (doing); although, even while
notes_reference_en: つつ alone is a written 〜ながら (two actions at once). つつも means 'although', typically with verbs of knowing or thinking (思いつつ, 知りつつ).

formation_reference_en: Verb-stem + つつある
meaning_reference_en: be in the process of; be gradually (changing)
notes_reference_en: Written style for change that is underway toward some result. Used with change verbs (増える, 回復する, 変わる), not with simple ongoing actions like 食べる.

formation_reference_en: Verb-stem + っぱなし
meaning_reference_en: leaving (something) as is; keep (doing) without a break
notes_reference_en: Either something left undone that should have been dealt with (often a complaint), or a state that goes on without a break. Conversational.

formation_reference_en: Verb-stem + 抜く
meaning_reference_en: do to the very end; see through; do thoroughly
notes_reference_en: Stresses finishing something hard despite difficulty, or doing it to the fullest (考え抜く, 生き抜く).

formation_reference_en: Verb-stem + 得る / Verb-stem + 得ない
meaning_reference_en: can; be possible / cannot; be impossible
notes_reference_en: Logical possibility, not personal skill (not ×泳ぎ得る for 'can swim'). The positive is read うる or える; other forms use え- (えない, えた).

formation_reference_en: Verb-stem + がたい
meaning_reference_en: hard to; almost impossible to (emotionally)
notes_reference_en: Used with verbs of thinking and feeling (信じる, 理解する, 許す, 離れる). Unlike 〜にくい, not for physical difficulty (×この肉は食べがたい).

formation_reference_en: Verb-stem + ようがない / Noun + の + しようがない
meaning_reference_en: there's no way to; cannot possibly (no means available)
notes_reference_en: There's no method at all, even if one wanted to. 〜ようもない is more emphatic. With suru-nouns: 説明のしようがない.

formation_reference_en: Verb-plain + ようでは
meaning_reference_en: if (you are like this / keep doing this), (it's no good)
notes_reference_en: Criticizes an undesirable state and predicts a bad outcome; the main clause is negative (〜ない, 困る, だめだ).

formation_reference_en: Verb-te + ならない / i-Adj-ku + てならない / na-Adj + でならない
meaning_reference_en: can't help (feeling); feel terribly; extremely
notes_reference_en: For feelings or impressions that arise on their own (気がする, 思われる, 心配だ, 残念だ). More formal and written than 〜てたまらない / 〜てしょうがない.

formation_reference_en: Verb-te + こそ
meaning_reference_en: only by (doing); only when
notes_reference_en: Stresses that A is the essential condition for the real value or result in B. 〜てはじめて (N3) is more neutral, focusing on timing.

formation_reference_en: Verb-te + からでないと / Verb-te + からでなければ
meaning_reference_en: not until (after doing); only after
notes_reference_en: The main clause is negative or expresses difficulty: B can't happen unless A is done first.

formation_reference_en: Verb-te + 以来 / Noun + 以来
meaning_reference_en: ever since
notes_reference_en: The main clause is a state or habit continuing from that past point up to now, not a single later event. More formal than 〜てから.

formation_reference_en: Verb-plain / Noun + に過ぎない
meaning_reference_en: merely; nothing more than; only
notes_reference_en: Downplays something as small or unimportant. Often with ただ or 単なる.

formation_reference_en: Verb-dict / Verb-nai / Noun + に限る
meaning_reference_en: nothing beats; the best thing is
notes_reference_en: The speaker's personal conviction that something is the best choice; conversational. For a more general 'it's best to', use 〜に越したことはない.

formation_reference_en: Noun + に限らず
meaning_reference_en: not only; not limited to
notes_reference_en: Widens the scope beyond A; the second part usually has も. Close to 〜だけでなく but a bit more formal.

formation_reference_en: Noun + に限って
meaning_reference_en: of all (times/people); precisely when; (someone) of all people wouldn't
notes_reference_en: Two uses: (1) 'just when', complaining that bad luck strikes at the worst time; (2) with はずがない / ない, firm trust that a particular person wouldn't do something.

formation_reference_en: Noun + に限り
meaning_reference_en: limited to; only (for)
notes_reference_en: Formal; typical of notices, ads and rules to state who or what a condition applies to.

formation_reference_en: Verb-dict / Verb-te + いる / i-Adj / na-Adj + である / Noun + である + かぎり
meaning_reference_en: as long as; as far as (to the limit of)
notes_reference_en: 'As long as' a condition holds, or 'as far as' the limit of knowledge or ability (私の知るかぎり, できるかぎり). Also written 限り. Different from 〜に限り (limited to).

formation_reference_en: Verb-nai + かぎり
meaning_reference_en: unless; as long as ... not
notes_reference_en: B holds as long as A doesn't happen. More emphatic and formal than 〜なければ.

formation_reference_en: Noun + にかけては / Noun + にかけても
meaning_reference_en: when it comes to; in terms of (skill)
notes_reference_en: Praises someone's ability in a specific field; typically followed by 誰にも負けない, 一番だ, 自信がある.

formation_reference_en: Noun + にこたえて / Noun + にこたえる + Noun
meaning_reference_en: in response to; meeting (expectations, requests)
notes_reference_en: Used with nouns like 期待, 要望, 声援, 要求. Also written 〜に応えて. Compare 〜に応じて, which means adjusting to a condition.

formation_reference_en: Noun + に先立って / Verb-dict + に先立って / Noun + に先立つ + Noun
meaning_reference_en: prior to; before
notes_reference_en: Formal; for preparations or events that come before an important occasion. 〜に先立ち is the written form.

formation_reference_en: Verb-plain / i-Adj / na-Adj / Noun + にしろ・にせよ
meaning_reference_en: even if; whether ... or ...; in any case
notes_reference_en: Same meaning as 〜にしても (N3) but more formal; にせよ is the most written. The paired form AにしろBにしろ means 'whether A or B'.

formation_reference_en: Noun + にすれば / Noun + にしたら
meaning_reference_en: from the standpoint of; for (someone), (it would seem)
notes_reference_en: Imagines how things feel from another person's position (usually not the speaker's). Unlike 〜にとって, it focuses on that person's feelings or opinion.

formation_reference_en: Verb-plain / i-Adj / na-Adj / Noun + に相違ない
meaning_reference_en: without doubt; must be; surely
notes_reference_en: A written, formal equivalent of 〜に違いない (N3). Also seen on forms: 上記の通り相違ありません ('the above is correct').

formation_reference_en: Verb-dict / Verb-nai / i-Adj / na-Adj / Noun + に越したことはない
meaning_reference_en: it's best to; nothing is better than
notes_reference_en: States a common-sense preference, often followed by が / けれど and a practical reservation. Compare 〜に限る, which is a more personal choice.

formation_reference_en: Noun + にほかならない / Verb-plain + から + にほかならない
meaning_reference_en: nothing other than; none other than; precisely
notes_reference_en: Strongly asserts that this and nothing else is the case. 〜からにほかならない stresses a reason. Formal/written.

formation_reference_en: Verb-plain / i-Adj / na-Adj + である / Noun + にもかかわらず
meaning_reference_en: despite; in spite of; although
notes_reference_en: A formal counterpart of 〜のに, common in news and writing; stresses that the result goes against what A would lead one to expect. Don't confuse with 〜にかかわらず (regardless of).

formation_reference_en: Noun + にあたって / Verb-dict + にあたって / Noun + にあたっての + Noun
meaning_reference_en: when; at the time of; on the occasion of (starting something important)
notes_reference_en: Formal; used when facing an important undertaking, often with a sense of preparation or resolve. 〜に際して is similar but simply marks the occasion. Written form: 〜にあたり.

formation_reference_en: Noun + において / Noun + における + Noun
meaning_reference_en: in; at; in the field of (formal)
notes_reference_en: A formal version of で for places, times, fields or situations. Before a noun, the form is 〜における.

formation_reference_en: Noun + にかかわらず / Verb-dict + Verb-nai + にかかわらず
meaning_reference_en: regardless of; irrespective of
notes_reference_en: Used with nouns implying a range or an opposite pair (年齢, 天候, 有無, 男女). Very close to 〜を問わず. Don't confuse with 〜にもかかわらず (despite).

formation_reference_en: Noun + にかかわる
meaning_reference_en: affecting; concerning (something important); relating to
notes_reference_en: Used for things with serious consequences: 命, 名誉, 信用, 将来. Also written 〜に関わる.

formation_reference_en: Noun + につき
meaning_reference_en: per; for each; due to (in formal notices)
notes_reference_en: Two separate uses: 'per' with quantities, and 'because of' on notices and signs (工事中につき). The reason use is very formal.

formation_reference_en: Noun + に向けて / Noun + に向けた + Noun
meaning_reference_en: toward; aimed at; in preparation for; addressed to
notes_reference_en: Marks a goal or event being worked toward, or the audience something is directed at. Different from 〜向け (N3), 'designed for'.

romaji: no moto de / no moto ni
formation_reference_en: Noun + のもとで / Noun + のもとに
meaning_reference_en: under (guidance, influence, a rule); with
notes_reference_en: Under someone's guidance, protection or influence, or under a rule or condition. Often written 〜の下で / 〜の下に.

formation_reference_en: Noun + 抜きで / Noun + 抜きに / Noun + 抜きの + Noun
meaning_reference_en: without; leaving out
notes_reference_en: Leaves out something normally included. 〜抜きには〜ない / 〜を抜きにしては〜ない means 'can't ... without'.

formation_reference_en: Noun + をこめて
meaning_reference_en: with (feeling); full of; putting ... into
notes_reference_en: Used with feelings or intentions (愛, 感謝, 願い, 心). Also written 〜を込めて.

formation_reference_en: Noun + を中心に / Noun + を中心として / Noun + を中心とした + Noun
meaning_reference_en: centered on; focusing on; mainly
notes_reference_en: A is the core or main part of a wider area, group or activity.

formation_reference_en: Noun + をもとに / Noun + をもとにして / Noun + をもとにした + Noun
meaning_reference_en: based on; using ... as a basis or source
notes_reference_en: A is the material or hint from which something new is made. 〜に基づいて is used when strictly following a rule or fact as a standard.

formation_reference_en: Noun + を問わず
meaning_reference_en: regardless of; irrespective of
notes_reference_en: Used with nouns implying a range or an opposite pair (男女, 昼夜, 国内外). Very close to 〜にかかわらず; を問わず is typical of job ads and notices.

formation_reference_en: Noun + をはじめ / Noun + をはじめとして / Noun + をはじめとする + Noun
meaning_reference_en: starting with; including; such as (a representative example)
notes_reference_en: Names the most representative member of a group, then refers to the group as a whole. The main clause covers many items, not just A.

formation_reference_en: Noun + を + Noun + として / Noun + を + Noun + とする
meaning_reference_en: treating (A) as (B); with A as B
notes_reference_en: Puts A in the role or function of B; common B nouns are 目的, 目標, 中心, 対象, 条件. 〜を〜にして is a more casual variant.

formation_reference_en: Verb-plain / i-Adj / na-Adj / Noun + かというと / Question word + … + かというと
meaning_reference_en: if you ask whether (actually, not); the reason why ... is
notes_reference_en: With a question word (なぜ, どうして) it introduces an explanation. Without one, it raises a question only to deny the easy assumption (〜かというと、そうではない). Also 〜かといえば.

reading: 〜かとおもったら / 〜かとおもうと
romaji: ka to omottara / ka to omou to
formation_reference_en: Verb-ta + かと思ったら / Verb-ta + かと思うと
meaning_reference_en: just when; no sooner than; the moment
notes_reference_en: B follows A immediately and unexpectedly. It describes what the speaker observes, so it isn't used for the speaker's own actions.

romaji: ka ... nai ka no uchi ni
formation_reference_en: Verb-dict + か + Verb-nai + かのうちに / Verb-ta + か + Verb-nai + かのうちに
meaning_reference_en: as soon as; barely ... when
notes_reference_en: The same verb is repeated in positive and negative: it's unclear whether A has even finished before B happens. Describes observed events.

formation_reference_en: Verb-ta + きり / Noun + きり
meaning_reference_en: since (and nothing after); only; just
notes_reference_en: Verb-ta + きり: something happened and the expected follow-up never came (often with ない). Noun + きり: 'only' (一度きり, 二人きり). Casual: 〜っきり.

formation_reference_en: i-Adj stem + げ / na-Adj + げ / Verb-stem + たげ
meaning_reference_en: seeming; looking (as if); with an air of
notes_reference_en: Describes a feeling visible in someone's face or manner; conjugates like a na-adjective (〜げな, 〜げに). Rather literary.

formation_reference_en: Verb-stem + っこない
meaning_reference_en: no way; there's absolutely no chance
notes_reference_en: Casual speech only; often with potential verbs (できっこない, 分かりっこない). A casual equivalent of 〜わけがない.

formation_reference_en: Verb-plain / i-Adj / na-Adj / Noun + どころか
meaning_reference_en: far from; let alone; on the contrary
notes_reference_en: Either the reality is the opposite of A, or not even something lesser than A is possible (AどころかBも〜ない).

formation_reference_en: Verb-dict / Noun + どころではない
meaning_reference_en: this is no time for; out of the question
notes_reference_en: The circumstances make A impossible or unthinkable right now. Casual: 〜どころじゃない.

formation_reference_en: Verb-plain / i-Adj / na-Adj / Noun + とは限らない
meaning_reference_en: not necessarily; not always
notes_reference_en: Denies that something is always true; often with 必ずしも or 〜からといって.

formation_reference_en: Verb-plain / i-Adj / na-Adj / Noun + というものだ
meaning_reference_en: that's what (A) is; that's just how it is; that's really
notes_reference_en: A firm opinion about what something really is or how things naturally are. Often used to criticize an attitude.

romaji: to iu mono de wa nai
formation_reference_en: Verb-plain / i-Adj / na-Adj / Noun + というものではない
meaning_reference_en: it's not (necessarily) the case that; it doesn't follow that
notes_reference_en: Rejects an oversimplified belief; often with 〜ばいい or 〜さえ〜ば. 〜というものでもない is a softer variant.

formation_reference_en: Verb-plain / i-Adj / na-Adj / Noun + といっても
meaning_reference_en: although I say; even though (it's called)
notes_reference_en: Corrects or limits what the listener might assume from the first statement. Often followed by たった, ただ or 〜しか〜ない.

formation_reference_en: Noun + といえば / Noun + というと
meaning_reference_en: speaking of; when you think of; if you mention
notes_reference_en: Introduces something closely associated with a topic, or picks up a word just mentioned to shift the conversation. 〜といったら is a more emotional variant.

formation_reference_en: Verb-dict + ほかない / Verb-dict + よりほかない
meaning_reference_en: have no choice but to; there's nothing to do but
notes_reference_en: A somewhat formal equivalent of 〜しかない (N3). Variants: 〜ほかはない, 〜よりほかない, 〜ほかしかたがない.

formation_reference_en: Verb-dict + まい / Verb-stem (ichidan verbs) + まい
meaning_reference_en: will not (resolve); probably won't (conjecture)
notes_reference_en: Written/formal. First person: firm resolve not to (〜ないつもりだ). Others: negative guess (〜ないだろう). する → するまい / すまい. Often 〜まいと思う / 〜まいと決心する.

formation_reference_en: Verb-volitional + ではないか / Verb-volitional + ではありませんか
meaning_reference_en: let's (formal call to action); why don't we
notes_reference_en: A strong, formal appeal to a group, typical of speeches and editorials. The casual version is 〜(よ)うじゃないか.

formation_reference_en: Noun + もかまわず / Verb-plain + の + もかまわず
meaning_reference_en: without caring about; regardless of; paying no attention to
notes_reference_en: Doing something without minding what people would normally care about (人目, 周囲, 雨). Often implies disapproval.

formation_reference_en: Noun + 上 / Noun + 上の + Noun
meaning_reference_en: from the standpoint of; in terms of; for reasons of
notes_reference_en: Attaches to Sino-Japanese nouns (歴史上, 経験上, 健康上, 表面上). Read じょう, not うえ.

formation_reference_en: Verb-dict + おそれがある / Noun + の + おそれがある
meaning_reference_en: there is a risk that; could (bad outcome)
notes_reference_en: For undesirable possibilities; typical of news, weather reports and official warnings. Also written 〜恐れがある. 〜かねない sounds more like the speaker's own judgment.

formation_reference_en: Verb-plain / i-Adj / na-Adj + な / Noun + の + せいか
meaning_reference_en: perhaps because; maybe due to
notes_reference_en: The speaker isn't sure of the cause. Mostly for bad or neutral results; for good results おかげか is also used.

formation_reference_en: Verb-plain / i-Adj / na-Adj + な / Noun + だけあって・だけに
meaning_reference_en: as might be expected (since); precisely because; all the more because
notes_reference_en: だけあって praises a result that matches expectations (often with さすが). だけに also means 'all the more because' and can lead to negative outcomes.

formation_reference_en: Verb-plain / i-Adj / na-Adj + な / Noun + だけのことはある
meaning_reference_en: it's no wonder; it lives up to; as expected of
notes_reference_en: Judges a result as fully justified by the effort, price or reputation; often with さすが. Like 〜だけあって, but placed at the end of the sentence.

formation_reference_en: たとえ + Verb-te + も / たとえ + i-Adj-ku + ても / たとえ + na-Adj + でも / たとえ + Noun + でも
meaning_reference_en: even if; no matter
notes_reference_en: たとえ signals a hypothetical 'even if' in advance and strengthens it. A more written variant is たとえ〜としても.

formation_reference_en: Noun + やら + Noun + やら / Verb-dict + やら + Verb-dict + やら / i-Adj + やら + i-Adj + やら
meaning_reference_en: what with ... and ...; and ... and (among other things)
notes_reference_en: Lists a few examples among many, often suggesting chaos or mixed feelings. Frequently followed by で + 大変だ / 忙しい.

formation_reference_en: Verb-nai stem + ずに済む / Verb-nai + で済む
meaning_reference_en: get by without; not have to; be spared from
notes_reference_en: Something unpleasant or costly turned out to be unnecessary. する → せずに済む. Compare Noun + で済む, 'be settled with just ...'.

formation_reference_en: Verb-stem + ようによっては
meaning_reference_en: depending on how (one does it)
notes_reference_en: Mostly with 考え, 見, 言い, 使い: the result changes with the way A is done. Often offers a positive reinterpretation.
